title: A lake valley at nightfall
text: Over the south ridge and down to a lakeside camp as night falls and the fireflies come out.

title: A canyon in golden light
text: Up the canyon floor between its walls in golden haze, rising toward the rim.

title: A dune desert at sunset
text: A low pass over the crests with sand drifting off them, rising at the end.

title: A snowy mountain pass at dawn
text: Up the saddle between the cliffs along a gravel trail, snow falling through the pines.

title: A cave descent
text: Down the ramp past a brazier into the cold blue bottom hall, then along the torchlit hall.

title: A forest stream
text: Along a dirt path beside a stream through old misty woods, past rapids and a small fall, out over a glade.

title: A gloomy swamp
text: Low over dark water between drowned trees and reed beds, rising once to the hut on its island.

title: Rolling grassland
text: Up a stony track through the game's own grass, over the crest to a pond and a stone circle.
